component.name: Kotilo Deck
component.summary: Full-screen developer dashboard for a secondary display
İkinci ekran için tam ekran geliştirici panosu

description.p: Kotilo Deck turns a secondary display, a small USB screen or an old tablet into a glanceable dashboard for developers.

ul.li: Clock, date, weather and calendar (ICS feeds)
System load, volume mixer and media controls (MPRIS)
Pomodoro timer, todos with reminders and AI agent status
Workspaces that switch by hotkey, time of day or pomodoro state
More than 30 developer colour themes, wallpapers and transparent overlays
Optional tablet/browser mode on your LAN and sandboxed widget plugins

description.p: Everything stays on your machine; there is no account and no telemetry.

screenshot.caption: A Focus workspace on a 7-inch display
Edit mode with the widget drawer

description.p: The connection to Kotilo desktop is now mutually authenticated.
